solution:
The correct answer is **3) a - ii, b - i, c - iv, d - iii**

** Food Technology:**

__
 
• **Food Technology refers to the application of science and engineering principles to the processing, packaging, and distribution of food products.**

**Food Science:**

 
• **Food Science refers to the study of the physical, biological, and chemical makeup of food and the concepts underlying food processing.**

** Food Resources:**

 
• **Food Resources refer to the availability and accessibility of food for human consumption,** and not the mass production of food products.

**Food Manufacturing:**

 
• Food Manufacturing refers to the process of **converting raw materials into finished food products on a large scale.**

 

 **Additional Info__**

 
• ** Food Technology: It involves the use of various techniques and technologies to improve the quality, safety, and shelf-life of food** products. It includes the development of new food products, packaging materials, and food processing methods.
 
• **Food Science: It encompasses a wide range of disciplines, including chemistry, microbiology, nutrition, and engineering, **to understand the properties of food and the effects of processing and storage on food quality.
 
• **Food Resources: It deals with the availability and accessibility of food for human consumption, including the production, distribution,** and consumption of food. It also includes issues related to food security, food waste, and food policy.
 
• **Food Manufacturing: It involves the use of machinery, equipment, and labor to produce food products on a large scale.** It includes processes such as milling, baking, canning, and freezing to convert raw materials into finished food products.
